# rustinion_silence (Resource)

Manages a Rustinion alert silence: a scoped, time-bounded mute of alert notification dispatch for a known issue. See silences.rs in the main repo for exactly which dispatch paths check this and how it differs from a maintenance window or an escalation policy. At least one of group_id, device_id, alert_rule_id, or tag is required. There is no update endpoint for a silence at all — every attribute here forces a replace. Deleting this resource cancels the silence server-side rather than removing its row.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ends_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp the silence ends at. Must be after starts_at — rejected server-side otherwise.
- `name` (String)
- `starts_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp the silence begins at.

### Optional

- `alert_rule_id` (String)
- `device_id` (String)
- `group_id` (String) Mutes every alert in this group. Combinable with device_id/alert_rule_id/tag rather than mutually exclusive.
- `reason` (String)
- `tag` (String)

### Read-Only

- `cancelled_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp this silence was cancelled at, if it has been. Null while active.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned silence ID.
